REC50-R43-002-P1: The December 6, 2021 order is formal policy evidence. The exact later presentation is linked from WTO's official May 16, 2023 meeting agenda and states the restriction remains in force; this date is supported by meeting provenance, not its filename. Goods are cottonseed, cottonseed cake, millet, sorghum, maize and local rice. No continuous all-post enforcement is inferred.

The World Bank's 2024 Niger update reports cereal-export relaxation by Mali in solidarity with Niger. The precise Malian instrument, effective date, commodities and other destinations remain unestablished, so this is not coded as a blanket repeal or an endpoint for cotton inputs.
